definitions.explanation: The opposition that a material or circuit presents to the flow of electric current. Measured in ohms. A fundamental concept in physics and electrical engineering.

examples.japanese: ⟦{銅|どう}→銅：19443_dou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{電気抵抗|でんきていこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧。
⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{電気抵抗|でんきていこう}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{増加|ぞうか}→増加：03329_zouka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: As temperature rises, electrical resistance also increases.

examples.japanese: {超伝導|ちょうでんどう}⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{電気抵抗|でんきていこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ゼロ→ゼロ：01011_zero⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦エネルギー→エネルギー：03834_enerugii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{損失|そんしつ}→損失：04875_sonshitsu⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{電流|でんりゅう}→電流：21016_denryuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{流|なが}す→流す：01968_nagasu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: In a superconducting state, electrical resistance becomes zero, allowing current to flow without energy loss.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧ (electricity) and ⟦{抵抗|ていこう}→抵抗：03540_teikou⟧ (resistance). The unit of measurement is オーム (ohm), represented by the symbol Ω. This is a standard term in physics education, appearing in middle school and high school science curricula.

Ohm's law ({オームの法則|ほうそく}) states that voltage (⟦{電圧|でんあつ}→電圧：19996_denatsu⟧) equals current (⟦{電流|でんりゅう}→電流：21016_denryuu⟧) times resistance ({電気抵抗|でんきていこう}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電気抵抗|でんきていこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: to have high electrical resistance
- {電気抵抗|でんきていこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧: to have low electrical resistance
- {電気抵抗|でんきていこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測定|そくてい}→測定：04398_sokutei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to measure electrical resistance
- {電気抵抗|でんきていこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{値|あたい}→値：21704_atai⟧: the value of electrical resistance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{抵抗|ていこう}→抵抗：03540_teikou⟧: resistance — the general term, also used as a component name (resistor)
- {抵抗器|ていこうき}: resistor — the electronic component
- {導電性|どうでんせい}: electrical conductivity — the opposite property, how well a material conducts
